lines.server: Server time per form: 83 s mean, 71 s median: the HTTP round trip of the answered request on the shared endpoint, 289 answered reads of Gemma-4-31B-IT, 2,609 tokens in and 804 out per form (about 10 output tokens a second per request).
lines.cost: About $24 of AMD compute to read all 169,005 national presidential tally sheets with Gemma-4-31B-IT ($0.000144 per form, the mean billed cost of 289 reads).
lines.wall: The 87 s per form reported for the 300 run is wall clock on a shared key under our own pacing (2 requests in flight), not GPU time; the endpoint's own round trip, which includes its queue, was 83 s of it.
